searchText: Pleasure <@1047790885577949224> ! In what way are you thinking? But in general yes! Contributing is permissionless so I'd say just pick an area and run ahead 🙂 if what you're asking is EF-specific involvement, we will keep pushing public roadmaps of what we're seeing as priority/where we're working on and perhaps in the future both publish wishlists and RFPs (request for proposals) for grants
